content.narrative_significance: This phase's target, train_memory_scene, was selected by re-evaluating the live three-way tie at 56 (bathhouse_arrival, bridge_crossing, train_memory_scene) under the established tie-break: primary criterion (fewest existing dedicated real chains) found train_memory_scene (28) the sole fewest among the tied trio (bathhouse_arrival=29, bridge_crossing=35), so it was adopted directly — no secondary alphabetical tiebreak was needed this time, unlike PHASE-236's pair. A registry-confirmed reuse-candidate search performed before this phase's authoring found 76 usable candidates for train_memory_scene (not zero, so no STOP was required); the lowest, guest_hall_0030, was already a leg once (payoff in chain_arrival_twenty_ninth_confirmed under bathhouse_arrival, PHASE-234), reused here citing its real, uncited train_memory_scene tag. A payoff search under the PHASE-199 policy found 56 valid candidates before the plant leg was written (not zero, so no STOP was required); because the plant scene was already excluded from this pool before this phase (it was already used as a leg, under a different anchor, before PHASE-237 began), the payoff is simply the lowest of the 56: spirit_bath_0055, which carries REAL tags for both train_memory_scene and bathhouse_arrival. This chain, named 'twenty_ninth_confirmed' extending the established chain_memory_* naming discipline, gives train_memory_scene its twenty-ninth dedicated real chain. FULL cross-anchor payoff-pool accounting, correctly distinguishing a REUSED (already-a-leg) scene from a GENUINELY NEW leg consumption: train_memory_scene itself drops by only ONE, not two, because the plant leg contributes no additional reduction (guest_hall_0030 was already excluded from every pool before this phase); bathhouse_arrival drops by one because the payoff scene carries a real bathhouse_arrival tag (56 -> 55), a cross-anchor reduction from the PAYOFF leg only; bridge_crossing, no_face_loneliness, and river_spirit_departure are unaffected. Full record after this phase: bathhouse_arrival 55, bridge_crossing 56, no_face_loneliness 55, river_spirit_departure 55, train_memory_scene 55 (this phase's target). Next priority by the largest-pool convention: bridge_crossing, sole largest at 56. No new payoff rule, contract, or algorithm introduced — the PHASE-199 policy is unchanged. Separately, this phase's Episode-fresh recount (episode-usage domain) found bridge_crossing/no_face_loneliness/train_memory_scene all still exhausted at 0 and bathhouse_arrival's single reserved scene correctly held back; with river_spirit_departure the only remaining usable source for the third consecutive phase, this Episode again draws both of its scenes from a single anchor category rather than two different ones — disclosed here per explicit instruction, not silently treated as business-as-usual.
